name: ow-tools
description: Runs code on your machine. The Claude Code add-on for the ow- skills: local call transcription with speaker separation (ffmpeg, whisper.cpp, pyannote), branded and accessible PDF, Word and PowerPoint export (pandoc, Typst), Excel from CSV with formulas, screenshots of a test environment in your own Chrome, read-only health checks, a redacted scan of a repository's committed history for secrets (gitleaks), digests, date arithmetic (with the US federal contract calendar) and hours arithmetic, and a session-start list of open workstreams. Audio never leaves the machine; only health and capture use the network, for what you list. Needs Node 20+ and the tools /ow-tools lists; it installs nothing itself.
